### Landman (2024) — The Dark Side of Wealth & Power 🛢️

Landman is a drama series starring Billy Bob Thornton as Tommy Norris, an experienced oil-industry fixer navigating the dangerous world of West Texas petroleum. Working between powerful executives, oil-field workers, and unpredictable business partners, Tommy must solve problems before they turn into disasters that could cost lives and millions of dollars.

As the oil business grows more complicated, Tommy faces deadly accidents, criminal connections, corporate rivalries, and pressure from every direction. While everyone fights for a bigger share of the fortune, he must make difficult decisions that threaten both his career and his family. In this industry, one wrong move can change everything.

The series explores greed, ambition, loyalty, family, and the true cost of success. It exposes the risks behind the wealth and reveals how money and power can push people into dangerous situations where trust becomes a luxury.

What makes Landman compelling is its gritty look at an industry built on risk, influence, and enormous profits. Beneath the oil fields and business deals lies a world where survival depends on experience, strategy, and knowing when things have gone too far.

💬 “In the oil business, everyone wants the fortune—but someone always pays the price.”

source_details.synopsis: Landman is an American drama series created by Taylor Sheridan and Christian Wallace, inspired by the podcast series Boomtown hosted by Wallace. Starring Billy Bob Thornton as a landman for an oil company, the show premiered on November 17, 2024, on Paramount+. In March 2025, the series was renewed for a second season, which premiered on November 16, 2025. In December 2025, the series was renewed for a third season. Despite some elements igniting controversy, the series has been received positively by critics overall.
